why: Activated after the 2026-09-07 live compatibility census. Every pre-contract open pull request is grandfathered only at its exact current head; any later push invalidates that exemption and must carry a valid contract and completion pair. This activation does not retire the legacy objects alias or change branch protection.
activation_gate: Every open pull request either carries a valid contract and report, or is listed by exact number and head SHA in grandfathered_prs.
Then set mode to 'enforced' and activated_at to that date, in the same pull request.
Making 'Agent work contract' a required context on main is a SEPARATE action, taken only after enforced mode has run green for a full day.
objects_alias_retirement_gate: Zero open claims and zero open work issues using the legacy `objects:` list. On 2026-08-23 that count was 1 claim and 29 issues, so the alias stays.
Plus at least 14 days of documentation and examples using `writes:`/`reads:`.

Until both hold, `objects:` keeps working and emits a visible deprecation warning. Do not retire it early: a legacy claim is read as a WRITE, and breaking that reading would let a writer start against work already in flight.
